visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor studio setting with a green screen background. A young woman with long, dark hair with pink highlights is dressed in a Harry Potter Gryffindor robe, featuring a red and gold tie. A stuffed white owl is perched on her left shoulder. She looks directly at the camera with a worried expression. (2) Close-up shot of a smartphone screen displaying a shopping website (Shopee) with a listing for a magic wand. A hand points at the price tag of NT$60. (3) The phone screen transitions to a map of Taipei near the main station, then switches to the Bolt ride-hailing app interface. Fingers interact with the screen to navigate menus and enter a promo code. (4) Tutorial sequence on the smartphone showing the Bolt app’s promotion for a 70% discount. The screen displays the promo code input field being filled with characters. (5) Exterior view from a moving car window showing a highway sound barrier and high-rise buildings under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. (6) Street-level shot of a gift shop with a festive, magic-themed display including pumpkin lanterns and various props. A white delivery truck is parked on the street. (7) Inside a car, a hand holds up a packaged black magic wand against the background of the vehicle's interior and a street outside. (8) Back in the studio, the woman in the robe is handed the new wand. She smiles and waves it, but then a hand brings in a 3D-printed brown wand. Her expression shifts to one of playful defeat as she looks at the 3D-printed version they had already prepared. (9) Close-up of the phone screen showing the trip history in the Bolt app with prices of NT$65 and NT$71 listed.

[Subtitle]: 這間店在北車 我們可以搭計程車去 最近這個 這個 好像很優惠. (5) [Variety]: 搭計程車!? (6) [Subtitle]: 你就去下載這個叫車App. 註冊之後 輸入你朋友的邀請碼. 要記得在首次叫車之前就輸入喔! 這樣就會有70%的折扣了. 這樣多少錢? (7) [Variety]: NT$65!! 比我的午餐還要便宜! narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video promotes the Bolt ride-hailing app by demonstrating its cost-effectiveness through a humorous 'emergency' scenario where a character needs a magic wand. It showcases the app's discount features and promo codes.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a direct tutorial on downloading and using the Bolt app, including a specific promo code and price comparison.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines a niche hobby interest (Harry Potter/Cosplay) with a practical app promotion, using high-energy editing to maintain viewer engagement.
